payload: Use the installed public data-analysis skill implementation to check two JSON exports. Locate its scripts/analyze.py, load it with runpy.run_path (without running main), create a real duckdb in-memory connection, and call its action_query(con, "SELECT 1 AS id, 2 AS id", {}, output_file) with a fresh JSON file under /mnt/user-data/outputs. Before export, print the actual DuckDB result column names and row values. Then print the exact exported JSON. Repeat via the same native function with SELECT 1 AS first_id, 2 AS second_id into a separate JSON file. Do not rename the first query columns, replace the export implementation, or patch the skill. Report whether both original values survive each export, including any errors and the real script path. This is a local diagnostic; no external data is required.
